messages: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
#p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p221##k, the leader of the archers. I'm a little nervous about meeting her!\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I greeted #p221#, the leader of the archers in #m10001000#. She seems strong and wise, yet very kind.
name: First Greeting with Athena Pierce
